grade_rationale.text: Afanasyev records the zlydni for Little Russia and gives a Belarusian proverb about them.
Ralston records a Little-Russian belief in the Zluidni, a Little-Russian curse and a White-Russian proverb, and cites no source on that passage.
Ralston's Maksimovich tale is marked as quoted by Afanasyev, so that tale is counted once.
Ralston's Little-Russian Likho variant, where the Zluidni sit around Likho, is marked as quoted by Afanasyev, so it is counted once.
Two peoples (Ukrainians, Belarusians) are each attested by Afanasyev and, on a passage that does not cite him, by Ralston.
